html:
OMNI-DC: metric depth completion for any sparse pattern; it predicts depth gradients at three scales and integrates them with the sparse points, helped by Depth Anything V2 Large. BSD-3 code, weights non-commercial (they include Depth Anything V2 Large).

Commercial use: no (weights: CC-BY-NC-4.0).

Speed and memory not measured for: omni-dc.

Details
  • Paper: OMNI-DC: Highly Robust Depth Completion with Multiresolution Depth Integration, ICCV 2025, 2024-11-28
  • Original code: https://github.com/princeton-vl/OMNI-DC at a5ecd35
  • Code licence: BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/princeton-vl/OMNI-DC/blob/main/LICENSE (BSD-3-Clause, also on the Hugging Face card zuoym15/OMNI-DC); the checkpoint's depth_module is the frozen Depth Anything V2 Large (upstream loads depth_anything_v2_vitl.pth, CC-BY-NC-4.0)
  • Training data: Synthetic RGB-D datasets with virtual sparse patterns per the paper (arXiv 2411.19278)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: omni-dc
  • Outputs: depth; kind: metric
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 16)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): omni-dc 1024x2048 (6.4 GiB peak allocated, 9.2 reserved)

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.005 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1.5 % and p99 <= 5 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output depth).

Limitations

  • The depth map is required: call the model with prompt_depth= a metric map in metres at the image size (another size is resized nearest; missing points as 0 / NaN / inf).
  • The weights include the frozen Depth Anything V2 Large (CC-BY-NC-4.0), so they are labelled non-commercial although the code and the Hugging Face card are BSD-3-Clause.
  • The integration is an iterative solve with a data-dependent step count: no ONNX / TensorRT export.
